name: Abdul El-Sayed

lean.basis: Progressive Democrat backed by Bernie Sanders, Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez and the UAW; won Michigan's 2026 Senate race as a Democrat.

summary: Abdul El-Sayed (born 1984), an epidemiologist and Rhodes Scholar, ran Detroit's health department from 2015 and Wayne County's health and human services department from 2023 to 2025, and lost the 2018 Democratic primary for governor. Backed by Bernie Sanders, he narrowly won Michigan's 2026 Senate primary despite nearly $30 million from AIPAC-linked groups against him, then beat Mike Rogers about 52% to 46% to become the first Muslim elected to the Senate.
